info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List External Agency Correspondent Bank Relationship Managements-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access and retrieve details about correspondent bank relationships managed by external agencies. It provides insights into the various relationships established for effective banking operations, facilitating comprehensive management and oversight. Typical consumers include banking professionals and financial analysts who require up-to-date information on how external agencies interact with correspondent banks. The endpoint supports use cases such as monitoring relationships, ensuring compliance, and enhancing communication between banks and their external partners.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of correspondent bank relationships associated with external agencies. It provides details necessary for managing banking partnerships effectively.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of correspondent bank relationships.
